I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from Pree's messages in that channel on 2025-09-03. At 14:06 she wrote that label printing had stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots and Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 she said it was resolved and Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I also warned him that the Central team weekly from 9/8 mentions Little Rock and Shreveport for the same outage. That was about gate check-ins being entered by hand, not label printing. He's on the Central team, so he can see that update too.

I only used sources Tobias can see himself, and I left out the finance details that showed up in the search results.
